description: 여수광양항만공사_관제정보_GW [ports and harbours] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 여수광양항만공사. 「관제정보」 데이터는 항만 관제 시스템에서 기록된 선박 작업 내역을 담고 있으며, 항만명(PRTNM), 호출부호(CALLLETTER), 선박명(VSSLNM), 연도(YR), 일련번호. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 여수광양항만공사. Its tags are 여수광양항만운영, 관제교신 정보, 선박명, 호출부호, 입출항구분. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-06-05 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
